set -eu
backup=/etc/fstab.before-antrieb-swap
if [ -e "$backup" ]; then printf '%s\n' "Refusing: $backup already exists" >&2; exit 1; fi
cp -a /etc/fstab "$backup"
chmod 600 "$backup"
printf '%s\n' '/swapfile none swap defaults,pri=100 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
if ! findmnt --verify --verbose; then
  cp -a "$backup" /etc/fstab
  printf '%s\n' 'fstab validation failed; restored original' >&2
  exit 1
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
